v1.feedback: The Worley-cellular lakebed is faithfully inherited and the iktsuarpok concept drives design convincingly — a figure coalescing from cracked earth is a strong metaphor for anticipation. The figure silhouette function uses axis-aligned rectangles, giving the walking human a blocky Minecraft quality; replacing it with a signed-distance-field or a bezier-sampled contour would lend the form the contemplative human specificity the concept deserves. The pewter moisture-shimmer in cracks is a nice temporal detail but at 0.38 max mix it barely registers against the clay — consider letting it pulse subtly (sinusoidal at 0.002 Hz) to evoke the rhythm of watching.

v2.feedback: Strong concept-to-form mapping — the SDF capsule figure rising from inherited Worley cracks is legible and the Gormley/Kiefer reference lands. The figure offset at x=2.0 is a nice compositional choice. To refine: consider a very subtle forward lean oscillation (breathing anticipation) once the morph completes, and darken the crack moisture tint slightly — the 0.32+0.16 pulse amplitude risks reading as too bright against the clay once multiplied by any blue-ish interior color in the truncated fragment shader. Also verify the figure's raised-arm silhouette reads at the default 78k density; if capsule radii are too tight, extremities may dissolve into noise at screen distance.

threejs.directive: Replace LineBasicMaterial+LineSegments with LineSegments2+LineMaterial (fat lines) for perspective-correct thread width — threads thicken as camera approaches, adding physical presence to the Shiota web.
